debate.key_bull_argument: Long-term structure (EMA 50/200, SMA 50/200, Supertrend) remains bullish with extreme fear sentiment (15/100) offering contrarian opportunity and support level at 285.52 providing defined risk.
debate.key_bear_argument: Severe macro headwinds (inverted yield curve, VIX crisis at 302.6, strong dollar), absent momentum confirmation (MACD negative, RSI weak, ADX non-trending), zero smart money signals, earnings risk in 40 days, and price below both 50-SMA and 200-EMA despite bullish long-term indicators create dangerous confluence of technical and fundamental weakness.
